what_you_believe_happened: Signed in, opened the avatar menu (top right), chose My account, saw a Two-factor login card showing Off. Typed my password in Confirm your password and clicked Set up two-factor login. The app showed numbered steps: install an authenticator app, scan a QR code (also an Add to authenticator app button and a typed setup key), then enter a 6-digit code. I entered a deliberately wrong code 000000 and got a red message 'That code does not match. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code. Check the details and try again.' I then clicked Cancel. 2FA remains off; could not go further without a phone app.
unnecessary_steps: Having to re-type my password to start setup (reasonable security, but it is a separate step before seeing any instructions)
confusing_terminology: Add to authenticator app -> button, unclear it is meant for opening on a phone; does nothing obvious on a desktop
Two-factor login vs two-step/MFA -> fine but 'login' wording slightly odd
missing_feedback: No visible confirmation text after Cancel (not verified beyond screenshot)
unexpected_behaviour: Avatar menu was not an obvious place to look; no 'Security' or 'Account' item in the left sidebar
errors_encountered: That code does not match. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code. Check the details and try again.
visual_issues: Error toast text is redundant ('Check the time...' then 'Check the details and try again')
Setup panel is long; the code field and button are below the fold, need scrolling
Error toast appears over page content bottom-right and disappears on its own
accessibility_issues: Avatar menu is an icon-only circle with letter A; no visible label
Theme buttons in the avatar menu are icon only (one icon renders as a tiny half-circle)
QR code has no visible text alternative, though a typed key is offered (good)
observations: Feature is easy once the avatar menu is opened. Page explains why it matters ('Strongly recommended for the Admin and anyone who approves money'), steps are numbered, and a typed setup key alternative exists. Cancel option provided. Wrong-code error is clear and helpful.
